Call Answer shows an alert when a caller needs you, a live call notification with Take over and End call, and a prompt to report spam after a call.
When a caller needs you, Call Answer shows its alert on top of the lock screen. On Android 14 and later this needs full-screen notification access.

When a delivery person calls, the Agent can send them the map to your home as a text message. The text is sent from this phone, from your own SIM, and your carrier\'s normal SMS rates apply. If you do not allow this, the Agent still answers calls but sends no map text.
